description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
When performing Basic Attack Stage 3, enter Reincarnate state.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Scarlet Coda

Phrolova enters the Compose state every 25s.
When the following 3 conditions are met, Heavy Attack is replaced with Scarlet Coda.
- Has 6 Volatile Notes.
- In the Compose state.
- Not in the Resolving Chord state.

Scarlet Coda: Consume STA to deal Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Each stack of Aftersound additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.
Casting this skill is considered as casting Echo Skill.
Casting this skill sends Compose state into cooldown and activates the Resolving Chord state.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.
Saat melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3, memasuki state Reincarnate.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Scarlet Coda

Phrolova memasuki state Compose setiap 25 dtk.
Saat 3 kondisi berikut terpenuhi, Heavy Attack diganti dengan Scarlet Coda.
- Memiliki 6 Volatile Note.
- Dalam state Compose.
- Tidak dalam state Resolving Chord.

Scarlet Coda: Mengonsumsi STA untuk memberikan Havoc DMG, Stagnate dan menarik target di sekitar. Damage ini dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Setiap stack Aftersound juga meningkatkan pengali DMG damage ini.
Melancarkan skill ini dianggap sebagai melancarkan Echo Skill.
Melancarkan skill ini memasukkan state Compose ke cooldown dan mengaktifkan state Resolving Chord.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

description.en:
Attack the target and deal Havoc DMG.
Casting this skill sends Phrolova into Reincarnate.
description.id:
Menyerang target dan memberikan Havoc DMG.
Melancarkan skill ini membuat Phrolova memasuki Reincarnate.

description.en:
Waltz of Forsaken Depths

Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. Waltz of Forsaken Depths does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the Resolving Chord state, Waltz of Forsaken Depths becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the Resolving Chord state, and Phrolova enters the Maestro state for 24s.

Maestro

Gain 120% ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the Volatile Notes in turn. Each Volatile Note holds for 4s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- Cue - Basic Attack: Press Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast Basic Attack - Hecate. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every 2 times Hecate casts Basic Attack - Hecate, the next Basic Attack - Hecate is replaced with Enhanced Attack - Hecate.
- Cue - Dodge: Press Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- Cue - Reset: Press Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- Cue - Curtain Call: Press Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast Curtain Call and end the Maestro state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts Basic Attack - Hecate to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to 10 times in total during Phrolova's Maestro state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect 1 times.
Switching back to Phrolova ends Maestro state.
Ending Maestro state removes all Volatile Notes.

Basic Attack - Hecate

Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings

When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Strings, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG and Stagnating the targets (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds

When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Winds, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza

When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Cadenza, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Curtain Call

Curtain Call can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing Havoc DMG.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the Maestro state.
- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the Maestro state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, press Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the Resolving Chord state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in Resolving Chord state, casting Curtain Call removes all Volatile Notes and ends the Resolving Chord state.
description.id:
Waltz of Forsaken Depths

Resonance Energy maksimum Phrolova adalah 0. Waltz of Forsaken Depths tidak mengonsumsi Resonance Energy.
Saat dalam state Resolving Chord, Waltz of Forsaken Depths dapat digunakan.
Melancarkan skill ini mengakhiri state Resolving Chord, dan Phrolova memasuki state Maestro selama 24 dtk.

Maestro

Mendapat peningkatan ATK sebesar 120%.
Phrolova melayang di udara dan memerintahkan Hecate untuk bertarung. Hecate berbagi stat dan status Phrolova, dan damage yang diberikan Hecate dianggap berasal dari Phrolova. Serangan Hecate tidak menghapus state Hazy Dream pada target.
Selama periode ini, Phrolova memainkan Volatile Note secara bergiliran. Setiap Volatile Note bertahan selama 4 dtk.
Jika Phrolova adalah Resonator aktif di lapangan, ia dapat memberikan aba-aba berikut kepada Hecate. Damage apa pun yang diterima Hecate dalam state ini juga memengaruhi Phrolova.
- Cue - Basic Attack: Tekan Normal Attack untuk memerintahkan Hecate melancarkan Basic Attack - Hecate. Saat Phrolova adalah Resonator aktif di lapangan, setiap 2 kali Hecate melancarkan Basic Attack - Hecate, Basic Attack - Hecate berikutnya diganti dengan Enhanced Attack - Hecate.
- Cue - Dodge: Tekan Dodge untuk memerintahkan Hecate menghindari serangan. Hecate tidak menerima damage dari serangan yang berhasil di-Dodge.
- Cue - Reset: Tekan Jump untuk me-reset posisi Hecate.
- Cue - Curtain Call: Tekan Resonance Liberation untuk memerintahkan Hecate melancarkan Curtain Call dan mengakhiri state Maestro.
Saat Phrolova bukan Resonator aktif, Hecate tidak menerima damage dan otomatis melancarkan Basic Attack - Hecate untuk menyerang target. Saat Resonator dalam tim melancarkan Echo Skill, Hecate melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate untuk menyerang target. Efek ini dapat dipicu hingga 10 kali secara total selama state Maestro Phrolova. Echo dengan nama sama dapat memicu efek ini 1 kali.
Berganti kembali ke Phrolova mengakhiri state Maestro.
Berakhirnya state Maestro menghapus seluruh Volatile Note.

Basic Attack - Hecate

Melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings

Saat Phrolova memainkan Volatile Note - Strings, Hecate melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings saat melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate, memberikan Havoc DMG dan Stagnate pada target (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds

Saat Phrolova memainkan Volatile Note - Winds, Hecate melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds saat melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate, memberikan Havoc DMG dan menarik target (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza

Saat Phrolova memainkan Volatile Note - Cadenza, Hecate melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza saat melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate, memberikan Havoc DMG, Stagnate dan menarik target (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Curtain Call

Curtain Call dapat dilancarkan melalui 5 cara berikut, Stagnate pada target dan memberikan Havoc DMG.
- Saat Phrolova adalah Resonator aktif di lapangan, mengakhiri state Maestro.
- Saat Phrolova dalam state Maestro, berganti ke Phrolova tanpa melancarkan Intro Skill.
- Saat Phrolova bukan Resonator aktif dan state Maestro berakhir, berganti ke Phrolova tanpa melancarkan Intro Skill.
- Saat Phrolova dalam state Maestro, tekan Resonance Liberation.
- Saat Phrolova dalam state Resolving Chord, tahan Resonance Liberation.
Saat dalam state Resolving Chord, melancarkan Curtain Call menghapus seluruh Volatile Note dan mengakhiri state Resolving Chord.

attributes.name: Waltz of Forsaken Depths Concerto Regen

description.en:
Casting Echo Skill grants increased resistance to interruption and reduces damage taken by 30% for 15s.
After casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, and Echo Skill, the next Volatile Note becomes Volatile Note - Cadenza.
description.id:
Melancarkan Echo Skill meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap interupsi dan mengurangi damage yang diterima sebesar 30% selama 15 dtk.
Setelah melancarkan Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, dan Echo Skill, Volatile Note berikutnya menjadi Volatile Note - Cadenza.

description.en:
Obtain 10 stacks of Aftersound upon entering battle. This effect cannot be triggered again within 4s after exiting the combat state. For every 1 stacks of Aftersound, Crit. DMG is increased by 2.5%.
When Aftersound reaches the max, each new stack of Aftersound increases Phrolova's Crit. DMG by 1%, up to 100%. The increased Crit. DMG is removed when Aftersound stacks are cleared.
description.id:
Mendapat 10 stack Aftersound saat memasuki pertempuran. Efek ini tidak dapat dipicu lagi dalam 4 dtk setelah keluar dari state pertempuran. Untuk setiap 1 stack Aftersound, Crit. DMG meningkat sebesar 2,5%.
Saat Aftersound mencapai maksimum, setiap stack Aftersound baru meningkatkan Crit. DMG Phrolova sebesar 1%, hingga 100%. Peningkatan Crit. DMG dihapus saat stack Aftersound dihapus.

description.en:
Suite of Quietus

Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Suite of Immortality

When in the Maestro state, the next Suite of Quietus is replaced with Suite of Immortality. This replacement is cancelled if Curtain Call is cast while in this state. Suite of Immortality deals Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and Stagnates the target.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
description.id:
Suite of Quietus

Menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Suite of Immortality

Saat dalam state Maestro, Suite of Quietus berikutnya diganti dengan Suite of Immortality. Penggantian ini dibatalkan jika Curtain Call dilancarkan saat dalam state ini. Suite of Immortality memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG) dan Stagnate pada target.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan skill ini untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

description.en:
Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality

When in Reincarnate, press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Movement of Fate and Finality, which Stagnates the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and ending Reincarnate afterward.

Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream

When in Reincarnate, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and ending Reincarnate afterward.

Aftersound

Phrolova can hold up to 24 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings, Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds, and Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza grants 1 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is out of combat, all stacks of Aftersound are removed every 30s.

Volatile Note

Phrolova can hold up to 6 Volatile Notes. When Volatile Notes reach the max number, gaining new Volatile Notes moves all Volatile Notes one slot to the left, and the leftmost Volatile Note - Strings or Volatile Note - Winds will be removed.
Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 or Movement of Fate and Finality grants 1 Volatile Note - Strings.
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill Whispers in a Fleeting Dream or Resonance Skill Murmurs in a Haunting Dream grants 1 Volatile Note - Winds.
When Inherent Skill - Accidental is activated, casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, or Echo Skill grants 1 Volatile Note - Cadenza.
Phrolova cannot obtain Volatile Notes during Resolving Chord.
description.id:
Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality

Saat dalam Reincarnate, tekan Normal Attack di darat untuk melancarkan Movement of Fate and Finality, yang Stagnate pada target, memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG) dan mengakhiri Reincarnate setelahnya.

Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream

Saat dalam Reincarnate, tekan Resonance Skill di darat untuk melancarkan Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, memberikan Havoc DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG) dan mengakhiri Reincarnate setelahnya.

Aftersound

Phrolova dapat menyimpan hingga 24 stack Aftersound.
Saat Phrolova bukan Resonator aktif, melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings, Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds, dan Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza memberikan 1 stack Aftersound.
Saat Phrolova di luar pertempuran, seluruh stack Aftersound dihapus setiap 30 dtk.

Volatile Note

Phrolova dapat menyimpan hingga 6 Volatile Note. Saat Volatile Note mencapai jumlah maksimum, mendapat Volatile Note baru menggeser seluruh Volatile Note satu slot ke kiri, dan Volatile Note - Strings atau Volatile Note - Winds paling kiri akan dihapus.
Mengenai target dengan Basic Attack Tahap 3 atau Movement of Fate and Finality memberikan 1 Volatile Note - Strings.
Mengenai target dengan Resonance Skill Whispers in a Fleeting Dream atau Resonance Skill Murmurs in a Haunting Dream memberikan 1 Volatile Note - Winds.
Saat Inherent Skill - Accidental aktif, melancarkan Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, atau Echo Skill memberikan 1 Volatile Note - Cadenza.
Phrolova tidak dapat memperoleh Volatile Note selama Resolving Chord.

description.en:
The incoming Resonator gains 20% Havoc DMG Amplification and 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
If Phrolova is in Maestro state when she casts this skill, Hecate additionally casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate 2 times when Phrolova is switched off the field while in the same Maestro state duration.
description.id:
Resonator yang masuk mendapat 20% Havoc DMG Amplification dan 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.
Jika Phrolova dalam state Maestro saat melancarkan skill ini, Hecate juga melancarkan Enhanced Attack - Hecate sebanyak 2 kali saat Phrolova diganti keluar dari lapangan dalam durasi state Maestro yang sama.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Movement of Fate and Finality is increased by 80%.
The DMG Multiplier of Murmurs in a Haunting Dream is increased by 80%.
If Phrolova has less than 2 Volatile Notes when she is not in the Maestro state and stays out of combat for 4s, she gains Volatile Note - Cadenza until she has at least 2 Volatile Notes.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Movement of Fate and Finality meningkat sebesar 80%.
Pengali DMG Murmurs in a Haunting Dream meningkat sebesar 80%.
Jika Phrolova memiliki kurang dari 2 Volatile Note saat tidak dalam state Maestro dan berada di luar pertempuran selama 4 dtk, ia mendapat Volatile Note - Cadenza hingga memiliki setidaknya 2 Volatile Note.

sequences.name: A Rope Tied to a Life Beyond

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Scarlet Coda is increased by 75%. Aftersound now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of Scarlet Coda by 75%.
Casting Scarlet Coda grants 14 stacks of Aftersound.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Scarlet Coda meningkat sebesar 75%. Aftersound kini juga meningkatkan pengali DMG Scarlet Coda sebesar 75%.
Melancarkan Scarlet Coda memberikan 14 stack Aftersound.

sequences.name: A Dagger to Cut Clean Obsessions

description.en:
Echo Skill DMG is Amplified by 80%.
Casting Scarlet Coda will convert all Volatile Notes to Volatile Notes - Cadenza in turn. Targets hit by Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza will have their ATK reduced by 20% for 15s.
description.id:
Echo Skill DMG di-Amplify sebesar 80%.
Melancarkan Scarlet Coda mengubah seluruh Volatile Note menjadi Volatile Note - Cadenza secara berurutan. Target yang terkena Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza mengalami pengurangan ATK sebesar 20% selama 15 dtk.

description.en: Casting Echo Skill grants 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
description.id: Melancarkan Echo Skill memberikan 20% Attribute DMG Bonus kepada seluruh Resonator dalam tim selama 30 dtk.

sequences.name: A Forked Road in Fate's Heartland

description.en:
Upon entering the Maestro state, generate a field to Stagnate the nearby targets, which lasts for 4s. Leaving the Maestro state or switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect early.
Damage taken during the Maestro state is reduced by 30%.
description.id:
Saat memasuki state Maestro, menghasilkan medan yang Stagnate pada target di sekitar, berlangsung selama 4 dtk. Keluar dari state Maestro atau berganti ke Resonator lain menghapus efek Stagnation lebih awal.
Damage yang diterima selama state Maestro berkurang 30%.

sequences.name: A Night to Depart From Eternal Rest

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Enhanced Attack - Hecate is increased by 24%.

During Movement of Fate and Finality and Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, command Hecate to cast 1 Apparition of Beyond - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 216.42% of Phrolova's ATK (considered Echo Skill DMG) and granting 8 stacks of Aftersound on hit.

If Phrolova is not the active Resonator during the Maestro state, targets take 40% more DMG from Hecate and Phrolova. If Phrolova is the active Resonator during the Maestro state, gain 60% Havoc DMG Bonus.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Enhanced Attack - Hecate meningkat sebesar 24%.

Selama Movement of Fate and Finality dan Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, memerintahkan Hecate melancarkan 1 Apparition of Beyond - Hecate, memberikan Havoc DMG sebesar 216,42% ATK Phrolova (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG) dan memberikan 8 stack Aftersound saat mengenai target.

Jika Phrolova bukan Resonator aktif selama state Maestro, target menerima 40% DMG lebih banyak dari Hecate dan Phrolova. Jika Phrolova adalah Resonator aktif selama state Maestro, mendapat 60% Havoc DMG Bonus.
